chooseLocationHint: Choose a location before you start scanning.

noneAssigned.title: No location assigned
noneAssigned.body: You're not assigned to any location yet. Ask the business owner to assign you one before scanning.

permission.title: Use your location?
permission.body: Your location is used only on your device to confirm you're at the right store before stamping. It never leaves your phone, and we never receive, store, or share it.

proximity.title: Wrong location?
proximity.body: You seem to be at {{name}}, about {{distance}} away. Want to switch to it?

errors.notPermitted: You're not assigned to this location. Pick one you're assigned to.
